OpenFang is an open-source Agent Operating System.
Not a "multi-agent orchestrator." A full operating system for autonomous agents, built from scratch in Rust.

OpenFang runs autonomous agents that work for you: on schedules, 24/7, building knowledge graphs, monitoring targets, generating leads, managing your social media, and reporting results to your dashboard.
